text.tspan: HINT: For a smoother voltage measurement
try to change fc=3 to fc=0.5 or 1 in the bus
Scroll to the end of the file
To see the simulation voltage results simply click on the lines
To see the currents click on the input pins of the device
The left buses measurement pins shows the line to line sinus voltages
The right buses measurement pins shows the line to line RMS voltages
